subject: Missing attachment question
text:
Hi Prof.,

I hope your week hasn’t swallowed you whole with marking yet. I’m writing because I opened your latest committee notes and noticed the appendix we talked about wasn’t actually attached. Before I started panicking in a neighborly sort of way, I thought I’d check: were you meaning to send the spreadsheet, or did the email arrive to me with only the summary pages?

Also, if the file is ready but simply got lost along the way, would you mind resending it when you have a quiet second? I’m happy to take it in whatever format works for you. I only want to make sure I don’t accidentally quote the older figures during Thursday’s discussion, especially since everyone else seems to have a different version on their laptop.

One other thing, because I’m already interrupting: do you know whether the revised room booking is still confirmed for the 4 p.m. slot? The corridor notice still says tentative, which may mean nothing, but it has made me second-guess my entire calendar.

Anyway, no rush unless Thursday is closer than it looks. Thanks for putting up with my constant little follow-ups, and please don’t feel you need to reply in the middle of something else. I can always find the information if you forward it once you’ve had coffee. If you are in the building later, I can collect a printout too. That may be easier than waiting for a printer to cooperate again. Sorry, old habit.

Best,
